Ghar par banaie juicy Chicken Pulao ( ) Perfectly fluffy basamti rice! Fragrant spices, tender chicken and roasted chatni make this easy one-pot recipe perfect for a delicious family meal.
Preparation time 10 minutes
Cooking time 30-35 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Chicken Marination
1 kg Chicken (thigh &drumstick), chikan
1 tbsp Tender Coriander stems with roots (finely chopped), dhaniya ke danthal
